Question
========







```{r p-quantile-normvert, message = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(mosaic)
z_vec <- seq(from = -2, to = 2, by = 1)

z <- sample(z_vec, size = 1)


mypercent <- pnorm(z_vec) 

correct_percent <- pnorm(z) %>% round(2)


questions <- mypercent %>% round(2)

solutions <- questions == correct_percent


o <- sample(1:length(z_vec))
questions <- questions[o]
solutions <- solutions[o]

# questions
# solutions

z <- round(z, 2)
```

Wie lautet der (kumulierte) Anteil der Wahrscheinlichkeitsverteilung der Variablen $X$ für den Wert $x=`r z`$? Wählen Sie die am besten passende Antwort!

Gehen Sie von dieser Verteilung aus: $\mathcal{N}(\mu = 0, \sigma = 1)$.




```{r questionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist( fmt(questions, 2), markup = "markdown")
```





Solution
========

der Prozentwert von $x = `r z`$ ist `r fmt(correct_percent, 2)`.

```{r solutionlist, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(solutions, "Richtig", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
